name: page
description: Make a free page: one complete HTML document you write yourself, kept as index.html in the artifact's folder with any files it needs beside it, opened as a live local page the person can use and comment on. The page can keep a small shared database, store files people add, hand the viewer a file to save, know who is viewing and talk to other open views, through the runtime capabilities you declare with the capabilities argument of Artifact publish. Use for a small interactive thing no other type fits: a widget or tool, a calculator, a mini game, an explainer page, a poll, checklist or sign-up sheet that remembers what people do on it. Not for a slide deck, a design to iterate on, a dashboard from data, a document, a spreadsheet or a film: those have types of their own.
